purpose: W2.4 deterministic retrieval and evidence-delivery comparison.
evidence_boundary: The 30 legacy records are candidate annotations, not Weave answer-quality gold. corpus.jsonl is constructed from legacy source ids and must_contain terms and proves only deterministic ranking mechanics.

source_lineage.migration_review: schema normalized; source existence and hashes recorded; semantic labels still require independent human review

evaluation_admission.Feature: W2 BM25 retrieval and evidence-delivery contracts
evaluation_admission.Risk: Chinese lexical tokenization, missing sources, or display changes may produce silent retrieval and evidence regressions.
evaluation_admission.Question: Does the W2 implementation improve deterministic regression and held-out retrieval while preserving explicit outcome and trust semantics?
evaluation_admission.Metric: Recall@3, MRR, outcome exact match, support exact match, trust exact match and inline-citation count.
evaluation_admission.Decision: Keep the smallest strategy that improves held-out cases; admit Dense/RRF/Ragas only when deterministic evidence cannot answer the product question.
evaluation_admission.ActionOnFail: Attribute failure to corpus, tokenization, retrieval, Evidence or rendering before changing strategy or adding a framework.
evaluation_admission.StopCondition: Metrics answer the current BM25 and delivery decision; further framework work cannot change it.

hash_policy: sha256 over UTF-8 text normalized from CRLF or CR to LF
